title: The Sentry scrub rewrites random ids: about 1 in 200 events gets event_id, trace_id, span_id or parent_span_id mangled
evidence: Fixed (US-09 AC7h): scrubEventText now scrubs contexts through scrubContexts, which puts back the original value only at contexts.trace.trace_id (32 lower-case hex), contexts.trace.span_id and parent_span_id (16) and contexts.trace.links[].trace_id/span_id, and only in that exact shape; any other value there, and an id-shaped value at any other path, is scrubbed as before. Same code in packages/health-core/src/sentry-scrub.ts and the repo-root instrument-scrub.mjs (the lead's app/lib path was wrong); the widget imports the health-core copy. event_id and event.spans[] ids were never visited by the text scrub, so they needed no exemption; tests pin them. Re-measured over 200,000 random trace contexts: 1.53% of events mangled before, 0 after. Tests: sentry-scrub.test.ts and instrument-scrub-parity.test.ts (US-09 AC7h), widget-src sentry-scrub.test.ts and sentry-pipeline-parity.test.ts.
